description: Fill and UV projections of bitmap sources (04 section 4, 5; task phase1.8_compositor-sources-projection): UV transform, Nearest and bilinear filters in the evaluator's arithmetic, wrap modes and island edges, with residuals of the evaluator's output against both recordings. Supersedes resampling.json for the evaluator.

entries.subject: UV projection with the Nearest filter (Repeat), any scale
entries.formula: Output texel (i, j) of the W x H set at u = (i + 0.5)/W, v = 1 - (j + 0.5)/H; (a, b) = ((u - 0.5 - o_u) s_u, (v - 0.5 - o_v) s_v) (the offset precedes the scale and the rotation, decision 056); u' = (cos r a + sin r b) + 0.5, v' = (-sin r a + cos r b) + 0.5, in double; bitmap texel coordinates x = u' w - 0.5, y = (1 - v') h - 0.5 (row 0 on top, centres at integers). The texel (floor(x + 0.5) mod w, floor(y + 0.5) mod h); its value float32(c / M) stored with the channel's write rule (the code itself at equal depth).

entries.subject: UV projection with BilinearHQ and BilinearSharp (Repeat), magnification and 1:1
entries.formula: Output texel (i, j) of the W x H set at u = (i + 0.5)/W, v = 1 - (j + 0.5)/H; (a, b) = ((u - 0.5 - o_u) s_u, (v - 0.5 - o_v) s_v) (the offset precedes the scale and the rotation, decision 056); u' = (cos r a + sin r b) + 0.5, v' = (-sin r a + cos r b) + 0.5, in double; bitmap texel coordinates x = u' w - 0.5, y = (1 - v') h - 0.5 (row 0 on top, centres at integers). Fixed point: X = floor(256 x + 0.5), x0 = X >> 8, fx = X & 255 (same for y); weights w11 = (fx fy + 127) >> 8, w10 = fx - w11, w01 = fy - w11, w00 = 256 - fx - fy + w11 on the taps (x0, y0), (x0 + 1, y0), (x0, y0 + 1), (x0 + 1, y0 + 1); texels t = float32(c / 65535); with E the binary exponent of the largest texel of non-zero weight (in [2^(E-1), 2^E)), operands floor(t 2^(28 - E)); value = their weighted sum times 2^(E - 36), rounded to the nearest float32 with ties up (a texel weighed 256 is unchanged), stored with the channel's write rule. This is the linear filter of a float32 texture on the GPU the goldens were recorded on (NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4090), measured by `uzp-evaluator-tests bilinear-hardware` at every 8-bit weight pair (16 777 216 samples, equal to the rule); the GPU rounds w11 ties up, which Painter's bottom-up bitmap turns into the ties down above. Repeat: tap indices modulo the bitmap size. BilinearHQ and BilinearSharp are identical here.

entries.notes: The filter's 28-bit operands are what Painter's values need: with the float32 texels summed exactly one value of s0 and s1 user2 (scale 1.37 x 2.11, texel (175, 18), green) is one code high, its sum lying 2^-9.7 ulp above a float32 midpoint where Painter rounds it down; operands of 27 bits break 16 values of s0, s1 and s3 (3 867 033 values), 29 to 33 bits keep the miss; truncating the sum or each product, round-toward-zero and float32 orders of the sum (at least 1630) do not fit. The GPU measurement fixes the rest of the rule (the exponent of the largest weighed texel, ties up), which the corpus cannot separate (task phase1.9_compositor-resample-gaps). Replaces the 20-bit integer value rule of resampling.json (about 280 values per map one code off).

entries.subject: UV projection with BilinearHQ and RepeatNone, magnification and 1:1
entries.formula: Output texel (i, j) of the W x H set at u = (i + 0.5)/W, v = 1 - (j + 0.5)/H; (a, b) = ((u - 0.5 - o_u) s_u, (v - 0.5 - o_v) s_v) (the offset precedes the scale and the rotation, decision 056); u' = (cos r a + sin r b) + 0.5, v' = (-sin r a + cos r b) + 0.5, in double; bitmap texel coordinates x = u' w - 0.5, y = (1 - v') h - 0.5 (row 0 on top, centres at integers). Fixed point: X = floor(256 x + 0.5), x0 = X >> 8, fx = X & 255 (same for y); weights w11 = (fx fy + 127) >> 8, w10 = fx - w11, w01 = fy - w11, w00 = 256 - fx - fy + w11 on the taps (x0, y0), (x0 + 1, y0), (x0, y0 + 1), (x0 + 1, y0 + 1); texels t = float32(c / 65535); with E the binary exponent of the largest texel of non-zero weight (in [2^(E-1), 2^E)), operands floor(t 2^(28 - E)); value = their weighted sum times 2^(E - 36), rounded to the nearest float32 with ties up (a texel weighed 256 is unchanged), stored with the channel's write rule. This is the linear filter of a float32 texture on the GPU the goldens were recorded on (NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4090), measured by `uzp-evaluator-tests bilinear-hardware` at every 8-bit weight pair (16 777 216 samples, equal to the rule); the GPU rounds w11 ties up, which Painter's bottom-up bitmap turns into the ties down above. RepeatNone: tap indices clamped to the bitmap; texels with u' or v' outside [0, 1) are not covered and keep the value below the fill (a coverage plane in the projected tile). RepeatHorizontally / RepeatVertically repeat one axis and treat the other as RepeatNone (not observed).

entries.subject: BilinearHQ and BilinearSharp under minification
entries.formula: Not reproduced. Painter samples a minified bitmap with the recording GPU's texture unit through Vulkan (decision 056); with that unit as the sampler the following reproduces every value of resample-uv-minify, resample-uv-impulse and the held-out resample-uv user 6, both filters, both wraps, both recordings (decision 060): the UV in float32, u' = fma(m00, u, m01 v) + m02 and v' = fma(m10, u, m11 v) + m12 with M = float32 of T(1/2) R S T(-1/2 - o); a float32 texture with a mip chain of four-texel means rounded to float32 ties up; an anisotropic sampler with maxAnisotropy 4; BilinearSharp one SampleGrad at LOD bias -1.5; BilinearHQ nine samples at (u', v') + DX ddx + DY ddy (fine derivatives, DX and DY in {-1/3, 0, 1/3}) with the gradients divided by 3, summed in float32 in the order centre, (+, 0), (-, 0), (0, -), (0, +), (+, -), (-, -), (-, +), centre with weights 4, 2, 2, 2, 2, 1, 1, 1, 1 / 16, blended with the level-0 bilinear sample C1 as fma(C1, 1 - alpha, acc alpha), alpha = clamp(min(|ddx|, |ddy|) w - 1, 0, 1). The texture unit itself has no closed-form software replica (decision 061: its probe offsets are a non-separable function of the 9-bit gradient mantissas), and its tabulated replica stops at the accumulation gate (decision 071: several probes are summed with an unresolved sub-ulp truncation), so the evaluator refuses a bilinear projection whose footprint exceeds one texel with evaluator:unsupported_source.

entries.subject: UV projections on meshes: island edges
entries.formula: The Fill and UV projections evaluate every texel of the UV tile, inside and outside the islands. On every texel whose centre a triangle of the texture set covers (the UV raster of src/render/uv_raster.h on the imported texturing mesh) the channel equals the export; the texels outside the islands are export padding (padding infinite), not the stack's value.
